---
title: "CKG Data"
---

CKG Data is the XML/DTD data framework used to move structured data in and out
of the ClimateKG knowledge graph while keeping data quality and portability.

## What it does

- Provides XML/DTD data packages for core AR6 datasets
- Supports validation against the ER model and data constraints
- Enables import/export workflows for Wikibase and related tooling
- Keeps data portable for distribution and reuse
